documentation.content: The 3-weekly VerbBoard persona review is due (issue #142). In the verbboard repo, ask Claude Code to run the persona-review skill (figures: `make persona-review-dry-run`, also on /admin/reports). When finished run `python -m tools.persona_review_done <date>` to clear the admin banner. The log line below carries the date, window and headline figures.
